Clean default, raw request. read_infosiga() returns processed tibble (clean = TRUE); clean = FALSE returns data exactly published. cleaning logic lives .infosiga_clean() must stay idempotent. Faithful layer, opinionated layer. .infosiga_clean() fixes types missing-value markers never renames columns, recodes category labels drops rows. Anything rewrites source says — IBGE municipality spellings, Title Case, merged categories — belongs .infosiga_tidy_labels(), users opt labels = TRUE. Original column names preserved (Portuguese). anglicise ; users cross-reference official data dictionary (dictionary_infosiga()). cache never poisoned bad download. Downloads go tempfile, validated (non-empty + ZIP magic bytes via .infosiga_is_zip()), copied cache. failed refresh leaves existing archive intact. Mirror fallback. infosigasp.zip_url infosigasp.dictionary_url may vector URLs tried order. Refresh reader. read_infosiga(refresh = TRUE) public update path. first interactive download asks confirmation reports approximate 120 MB size; explicit refreshes prompt .

title: Getting started with infosigasp
text: INFOSIGA-SP São Paulo State Traffic Accident Information Management System, maintained DETRAN-SP. publishes, open data, detailed records every traffic crash state São Paulo 2015 onward. infosigasp downloads imports records. handles makes raw files awkward read directly. files use Latin-1 (ISO-8859-1), UTF-8. Semicolons (;) separate fields. Decimal numbers, coordinates, use comma decimal mark. Dates follow DD/MM/YYYY. dataset spans two files (2015–2021 2022 onward).
code: library(infosigasp)

title: Getting started with infosigasp
text: INFOSIGA-SP organises data three linked tables. sinistros — crash events. One row per recorded event, date, time, location (including latitude/longitude), road attributes breakdown many vehicles victims involved, type severity. pessoas — people (victims). One row per person involved, demographic attributes, injury severity , fatalities, date place death. veiculos — vehicles. One row per vehicle involved, make/model, manufacturing model years, colour type. three share id_sinistro key, can joined together; pessoas veiculos additionally share id_veiculo.

title: Getting started with infosigasp

code: sinistros <- read_infosiga("sinistros") sinistros recent <- read_infosiga("sinistros", year = 2022:2025)

title: Getting started with infosigasp
text: default read_infosiga() returns processed dataset (clean = TRUE). processing never renames columns, recodes category labels drops rows. fixes types source artefacts. full pipeline documented ?read_infosiga; main steps . Dates times. Full dates parsed Date times hms (modes), ano_mes_* year-month columns (published "YYYY/MM") become first--month Date values. Whitespace. Text columns lose leading trailing whitespace. source pads fields fixed width (nacionalidade ships "BRASILEIRA          "); untrimmed, values break grouping joins. Missing values. "NAO DISPONIVEL" (“available”) marker becomes NA (trimming runs first, space-padded markers caught). dia_da_semana: Domingo < … < Sábado (Brazilian week starts Sunday); turno: MADRUGADA < MANHA < TARDE < NOITE; gravidade_lesao (victims): LEVE < GRAVE < FATAL; faixa_etaria_demografica / faixa_etaria_legal: age bands order. Crash-type flags. binary tp_sinistro_* columns ("S" / empty) become logical, can sum() filter directly. categorical tp_sinistro_primario stays text. Numeric strings. tempo_sinistro_obito (days crash death) becomes integer, numero_logradouro loses spurious trailing ".0" export appends ("193.0"). Coordinates. latitude/longitude outside São Paulo state bounding box become NA pair. mis-encoded values (0, 0) placeholders, percent records. rows dropped; pass clean = FALSE raw coordinates. dia_da_semana ordered factor, weekday tabulation comes calendar order rather alphabetically. Pass clean = FALSE rather data exactly published, every text column character vector "NAO DISPONIVEL" source’s whitespace padding preserved verbatim.
code: sinistros <- read_infosiga("sinistros") levels(sinistros$dia_da_semana) table(sinistros$dia_da_semana) raw <- read_infosiga("sinistros", clean = FALSE)

Vehicle colour clearest case. source carries dozens distinct values sixteen real colours, two upstream systems coexist every year, one upper-case one title-cased, two disagree gender agreement. Note toupper() alone merge Branca Branco. remaining changes listed . Place names. source publishes municipio unaccented ("SAO PAULO") regiao_administrativa keeps accents, neither joins Brazilian data published. take official IBGE spelling. profissao Title Cased, merges several hundred values differ another capitalisation, stray "NAO INFORMADA" markers become NA. conservacao mixes name maintaining body ("PREFEITURA") bare route codes ("10.03"); codes move new conservacao_codigo column. Two limits worth naming. profissao keeps unaccented spelling occupations stay ungrouped, authoritative list covers free-text values. conservacao names keep source capitalisation, brand acronyms (SPMAR, TEBE, CART) Title Case corrupt Spmar Tebe.

title: Getting started with infosigasp
text: Always join cod_ibge, never name. IBGE INFOSIGA-SP spell nine municipalities differently. Eight contain apostrophe INFOSIGA-SP renders space ("Santa Bárbara d'Oeste" "SANTA BARBARA D OESTE"), IBGE’s "São Luiz Paraitinga" appears "SAO LUIS PARAITINGA". name join loses nine silently. cod_ibge also standard Brazilian municipality key, joins INFOSIGA-SP census population data. denominators turn crash counts crash rates.

title: infosigasp 0.1.0
text: Initial release. Added dictionary_infosiga(), downloads returns official PDF dictionaries datasets selected dataset. Added read_infosiga(), downloads imports sinistros, pessoas veiculos datasets tibbles. handles source encoding, types cleaning, supports raw data clean = FALSE, standardises inconsistent category labels labels = TRUE, refreshes local data refresh = TRUE. first interactive download asks confirmation reports approximate size. Documented coverage caveats source data ?read_infosiga getting-started vignette, chief among 2015–2018 covers fatal crashes , unrestricted per-year count jumps roughly 20-fold 2019. Added package hex logo drawn major road network São Paulo Metropolitan Region INFOSIGA-SP dark blue (data-raw/logo.R).
